notes: ἐνώπιον is improper and takes in the sight of whole, headed on the frame's lexical noun sight (rules 71, 95); no Greek article follows it to compete for the trailing of.
προνοούμενοι → Take thought for heads on thought, take being the empty support verb (rules 17, 91), and for is the verb's own, καλά being accusative (rule 106).
μηδενί heads on no rather than on the supplied man (rules 17, 69), and καλά, being anarthrous, heads on the adjective with things as its supplied completion (rule 17's anarthrous clause).
